maxAgentsNote: One more than the 3 agents defined below — deliberate headroom for a 4th specialist. platform-agent-stack/setup.sh reads this value rather than hardcoding it, so the two cannot drift.

agents.description: Classifies each incoming request — infra incident, ITSM ticket, or knowledge lookup — and routes to the matching specialist agent.

agents.notes: Existing HolmesGPT setup from ai-capabilities. azure-mcp added read-only (readOnlyMode: true — matches current azure/aks footprint; aws-mcp/gcp-mcp available the same way if the multi-cloud state work in mongostate-crossplane ever needs matching investigation coverage there). holmesgpt-runbook-mcp adds runbook_search/get/root_cause_analyse (read) plus runbook_draft, which opens a draft PR/MR — a write action, now gated by actionPolicy same as itsm-support. Kubernetes Remediation (MCP) exists upstream (restart/scale/drain) but is deliberately not enabled — would need the same tiering before it is.

ITSM backend and risk policy live in this same repo (../itsm-providers, ../policy) — a policy change and the mapping change it depends on are one commit and one review. Confluence via direct REST read, for environments where Confluence MCP isn't available or wanted.

_layout: Single repo. swarm/, policy/, itsm-providers/, llm-providers/ and confluence-toolset/ are directories, not sibling repos — paths below are relative to this file. ruflo-bridge and mongostate-crossplane remain separate repos because both are independently released artifacts.
